name: account-switcher
description: Keeps every Claude account you sign in with in a file of its own (tokens, email, name, organization), switches the session to another one on the spot – writing the current account's tokens back first – and reads each account's 5-hour and 7-day limits without switching. The model can do it too, if you let it (on by default), to spread work over your accounts. Works with CTM.

allowModelSwitch.title: Let the model switch accounts
allowModelSwitch.description: The model may switch to another saved account on its own, e.g. when a limit runs high. /account auto on|off overrides it.

switchCooldownMinutes.title: Minimum time between two switches by the model (minutes)
switchCooldownMinutes.description: Guards against the model switching back and forth. Your own /account switch is never held back. 0 = none.

alwaysAsk.title: Always ask before the model switches to
alwaysAsk.description: Comma-separated emails, domains (@wemotion.io) or organization names. For these accounts the model must always ask you first; /account allow cannot lift it. Set it in managed settings to enforce it for an organization.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of /account, the settings pane and the dialogs. auto = Claude Code's language setting, else the system's (LANG), else English. What the model reads stays English.

autoSave.title: Save every account you sign in with
autoSave.description: An account you /login with is saved to the account store on its own, and the tokens of the active account are written back there whenever Claude Code renews them.

storeDir.title: Account store folder
storeDir.description: Where the account files go, one per account. Empty = <Claude config dir>/account-switcher/accounts.

keychainService.title: macOS keychain item (advanced)
keychainService.description: The keychain service Claude Code keeps its login under on macOS. Empty = detect (Claude Code-credentials).
